origin_lemma.etymology: 3303 kumārá m. 'boy' RV., 'prince' Ragh., °aká- m. 'little boy' RV. (*°akā- f. in Kho.), °rī́-, °rikā́-, f. 'young girl' AV. [Orig. 'weak, tender', cf. kumārá-dēṣṇa- opp. to skambhá-d° RV. and perh. conn. kōmalá-, cf. sukumāra- ~ sukōmala- EWA i 232, 565 with lit.]
